create_sgmcmc_config: create an SGMCMCConfig dataclass with learning rate, prior variance, and MCMC hyperparameters
build_sgmcmc_agent: build a sgmcmc agent factory that trains a MLP via stochastic gradient MCMC sampling
run_extract_enn_sampler: run extract_enn_sampler to generate a JIT-compiled epistemic sampler from a list of saved parameters
test_get_preconditioner: test get_preconditioner to select RMSprop or None preconditioner based on config
summarize_make_agent: summarize make_agent factory that configures ENN, loss, optimizer, and trains via SGLD
